diagnostics.message: The direct dependency on project_services is redundant: google_project_iam_member.service_agents already depends on google_project_service_identity.default, which itself depends on project_services.
The direct dependency on project_services is redundant: google_logging_project_sink.sink depends on IAM binding/member resources, each of which already depends on project_services.

The direct dependency on project_services is redundant: google_project_iam_member.shared_vpc_host_robots already depends on service identities, default service accounts, and service-account data sources that depend on project_services.

The direct dependency on project_services is redundant: google_compute_subnetwork_iam_member.shared_vpc_host_robots already depends on service identities, default service accounts, and service-account data sources that depend on project_services.

The direct dependency on project_services is redundant: google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_agent_cmek already depends on service identities and service-agent IAM resources that depend on project_services.

google_monitoring_notification_channel.channels creates project notification channels but has no ordering dependency on project_services. If monitoring.googleapis.com is enabled by this module, channel creation can race API activation.

google_monitoring_alert_policy.alerts creates alert policies in the project but has no dependency on project_services; when monitoring.googleapis.com is enabled by this module, policy creation can race API activation, particularly when channels are external or none are configured.
google_logging_metric.metrics creates a project logging metric but does not wait for project_services. If logging.googleapis.com is enabled by this module, metric creation can race API activation.

google_logging_project_exclusion.logging-exclusion creates a project logging exclusion but does not wait for project_services. If logging.googleapis.com is enabled by this module, exclusion creation can race API activation.
google_logging_log_scope.log-scopes creates project log scopes but does not wait for project_services. If logging.googleapis.com is enabled by this module, log-scope creation can race API activation.

The Shared VPC service-project association uses Compute Engine functionality but has no ordering edge to project_services. When compute.googleapis.com is enabled by this module, association can race API activation.
